decision_description: Confirmed the Phase 2 concept-to-call alignment for FIELDWISE (MSCA-PF, HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01). All eight Tier 2B expected outcomes (EO-01 through EO-08) were mapped to concrete Tier 3 concept evidence in topic_mapping.json, and every mandatory scope requirement (SR-01, SR-02, SR-03, SR-06, SR-07, SR-08) and its paired call constraint (CC-01, CC-03, CC-04, CC-07, CC-09, CC-10) is recorded as covered in the concept_refinement_summary scope_coverage; SR-04/CC-02/CC-06 and CC-11/CC-12 are recorded as not_applicable with Tier 2B-grounded justification, and SR-05/CC-05 as partially_covered (no formal secondment proposed, half-duration limit not breached). The concept_refinement_summary scope_conflict_log is empty: no unresolved scope conflict remains between the concept and Tier 2B. The five research-topic claims flagged in the prior scope_check entry (topic-scope-check_30665934.json) are not treated as scope conflicts because the MSCA-PF Tier 2B scope_requirements.json and call_constraints.json define only structural, mobility, duration, training, and eligibility requirements and contain no thematic required_focus or excluded_topic element against which the water-stress/irrigation research theme could be affirmatively matched or found to conflict.
alternatives_considered: Escalate the five flagged research-topic claims from the scope_check entry into scope_conflict_log entries and hold the Phase 2 gate as unresolved. Rejected: Tier 2B for this call defines no thematic scope element, so there is no higher-tier constraint the claims could contradict; recording a conflict where no Tier 2B authority exists would fabricate a constraint contrary to CLAUDE.md §13.2.

Assert the research theme as affirmatively in-scope by supplying a thematic scope element from general programme knowledge. Rejected under CLAUDE.md §10.6 and §13.2: no such element exists in the loaded Tier 2B sources and it must not be invented.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 2 gate condition (topic mapping confirmed; concept vocabulary aligned with call expected outcomes; no unresolved scope conflict), applied with Tier 2B expected_outcomes.json, scope_requirements.json and call_constraints.json as the scope authority
rationale: The Phase 2 gate condition requires that topic mapping is confirmed, that concept-note vocabulary is aligned with the call-specific expected outcomes, and that no unresolved scope conflicts remain between the concept and Tier 2B. topic_mapping.json confirms an EO-01..EO-08 to Tier 3 evidence mapping, the concept_refinement_summary records full expected-outcome coverage and scope-requirement coverage with a Tier 2B-grounded status for every element, and its scope_conflict_log is empty. The prior scope_check flags are correctly left as thematic gaps rather than conflicts because Tier 2B supplies no thematic scope authority to conflict with; this preserves the CLAUDE.md §13.2 prohibition on inventing call constraints while satisfying the Phase 2 gate. Recording this determination durably in Tier 4 is required by CLAUDE.md §9.4 so the alignment basis is auditable by downstream phases rather than held only in agent memory.
